scientific_integrity: All new counts, orbit and purity properties are reproduced by complete finite programs; the seven-color assignment is an independently checked contextual witness. No independence or external publication priority is certified.
scientific_limitations: Finite theorem for the Coxeter graph only; complete search certificates rather than an infinite-family formula. The strong chromatic index seven was already reported by Abiad and Reijnders (2025), so it is not claimed as new. Unindexed matching-packing data may pose publication-priority risk.
title: Extremal induced matchings of the Coxeter graph form a pure four-packing geometry
